## Description

End-to-end testing of form submissions, input validation, user interactions with checkboxes, radio buttons, keyboard events, and file uploads.

## Pages Covered

| #   | Page Name          | URL Path              |
| --- | ------------------ | --------------------- |
| 1   | Simple Form Demo   | `/simple-form-demo`   |
| 2   | Input Form Submit  | `/input-form-submit`  |
| 3   | Ajax Form Submit   | `/ajax-form-submit`   |
| 4   | Checkbox Demo      | `/checkbox-demo`      |
| 5   | Radio Buttons Demo | `/radio-buttons-demo` |
| 6   | Key Press          | `/key-press`          |
| 7   | Upload File Demo   | `/upload-file-demo`   |

## What to Handle

- Form field input and validation
- Single and multi-option selections (checkboxes, radio buttons)
- Keyboard event handling and keystroke detection
- File upload interactions
- Synchronous and asynchronous form submission
- Error and success states

## Acceptance Criteria

- ✅ All 7 pages accessible and forms respond to user input
- ✅ Form validation (required fields, input types) tested
- ✅ Checkbox and radio button selection/deselection work
- ✅ Keyboard events (key press detection, special keys) captured
- ✅ File upload mechanism functional and validated
- ✅ AJAX form submission and response handling verified
- ✅ All tests use `setup('<page name>')` fixture
- ✅ Page objects created for form interactions
- ✅ Assertions separate in dedicated files

## Out of Scope

- Performance testing (load times, response times)
- Cross-browser specific rendering bugs
- Accessibility compliance (WCAG) beyond basic structure
- Mobile responsiveness (tested only on desktop)
- Data persistence across sessions
- Backend API integration beyond form submission response
